attributes.name: hands_at_face_front
attributes.text: The hands are active directly in front of the face.
attributes.definition: The active hand or hands are at face height, in front of the mouth, nose or eyes, near the body's midline.

attributes.name: hands_above_head
attributes.text: The hands are active above the head.
attributes.definition: The active hands reach a height above the top of the head.

attributes.name: hands_beside_head
attributes.text: The hands are active at the sides of the head.
attributes.definition: The active hands are at head height but out to the side of the head rather than in front of the face.

attributes.name: hands_close_in_front_of_chest
attributes.text: Both hands are held close together in front of the chest.
attributes.definition: Both hands are near each other at chest height, in front of the torso near the midline.

attributes.name: hands_low_front_waist
attributes.text: The hands are active low in front of the body at waist height.
attributes.definition: The active hands are in front of the body at or below the waist, roughly at table height.

attributes.name: hands_near_floor
attributes.text: The hands are active near the floor.
attributes.definition: The active hands drop to about knee height or lower in front of the body.

attributes.name: hands_behind_body
attributes.text: The hands are active behind the body.
attributes.definition: The active hands move behind the plane of the torso (back, behind the shoulders).

attributes.name: hand_at_hip_side
attributes.text: The hand is active beside the hip.
attributes.definition: The active hand is at the side of the body at hip height, not in front of it.

attributes.name: hand_far_in_front
attributes.text: The hand reaches far out in front of the body.
attributes.definition: The active hand is held at nearly full arm length in front of the shoulder.

attributes.name: hand_raised_front_chest_to_shoulder
attributes.text: A single hand is raised in front of the body between chest and shoulder height.
attributes.definition: One hand is lifted with a bent elbow to between chest and shoulder height in front of the body, not reaching the face.

attributes.name: hand_crosses_midline
attributes.text: A hand moves across to the opposite side of the body.
attributes.definition: The active hand passes the body midline and works on the other side.

attributes.name: arms_out_to_sides
attributes.text: The arms are held or swung out to the sides of the body.
attributes.definition: The hands are clearly lateral to the shoulders, away from the torso sides.
